questions.question: God promised to change the hearts of His people Israel. Which swap did He promise?

answers.text: A heart of stone for a heart of flesh
A heart of iron for a heart of gold
A heart of fear for a heart of courage

questions.question: God promised to put His Spirit within Israel. What did He say His Spirit would cause them to do?

answers.text: Walk in His laws and keep them carefully
Rule over the nations around them
Build Him a new house in Jerusalem

questions.question: After scattering Israel among the nations, God promised to show the holiness of His name. What will the nations then know?

answers.text: That Israel is the greatest nation
That their own idols have power

questions.question: God told the people of Israel that they would have to make themselves clean. True or false?
